gloss: any more (than this); any further; beyond this

definitions.gloss: any more (than this); any further; beyond this point
definitions.explanation: Refers to exceeding the current state or level. Most commonly used in negative sentences to mean 'not any more than this' or with ない to express that something cannot continue further.

examples.japanese: これ{以上|いじょう}{待|ま}てない。
これ{以上|いじょう}{迷惑|めいわく}をかけたくない。
examples.english: I don't want to cause any more trouble.

examples.japanese: これ{以上|いじょう}{値段|ねだん}を{下|さ}げることはできません。
examples.english: We cannot lower the price any further.

notes:
これ{以上|いじょう} combines the demonstrative これ (this) with {以上|いじょう} (above, more than) to mean "more than this" or "beyond this point." It is overwhelmingly used with negative predicates to indicate a limit has been reached.

USAGE:
Almost always followed by a negative expression (～ない, ～できない, ～たくない). In positive sentences, it is rare and usually rhetorical: これ{以上|いじょう}{何|なに}を{求|もと}めるのか (what more could one ask for?).

RELATED PATTERNS:
- それ{以上|いじょう}: more than that; beyond that
- あれ{以上|いじょう}: more than that (something further away or in the past)
- これ{以下|いか}: below this; no less than this

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- これ{以上|いじょう}ない: there is nothing more; the best possible
- これ{以上|いじょう}{続|つづ}けられない: cannot continue any further
- これ{以上|いじょう}{我慢|がまん}できない: cannot endure any more
- これ{以上|いじょう}ない{幸|しあわ}せ: the greatest happiness
